|lore=Hard-working Avenger signal officer. Coordinates and tests tractor beam operations. Apprises Executor of his ship's activities and relays orders from the flagship to his captain.
|anagram=The fan list pairs M'Kae with [[Mark Tuttle|Mark McKay]]. |game_text=Adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots. May use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take any one tractor beam, Our First Catch Of The Day or Besieged into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.

* Printed face: [[Warrant Officer M'Kae]]
|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Warrant Officer M'Kae", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). Hansen calls M'Kae a pilot built for tractor beam decks: he adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots and can take any tractor beam, [[Our First Catch Of The Day]] or [[Besieged]] into hand from Reserve Deck, which makes him a weapon against Hidden Base. He also suggests playing M'Kae without tractor beams so that opponents expect them and avoid a Star Destroyer's location. "Whenever you influence the gameplay of an opponent, you create an advantage for yourself that may be exploitable for a victory."<ref name="hansen-neglected13">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles/neglected13.html "Warrant Officer M'Kae" review], Jeff Hansen, Neglected Card Series, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202044314/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/articles/neglected13.html Internet Archive] (oocities.org mirror of the GeoCities page).
